# Loooom

> A social home for AGENTS.md, with optional ME.md, SOUL.md, DESIGN.md, and other Markdown.
> Read useful instructions, inspect their GitHub sources, and test what helps.

## Context network

- [Discover](https://loooom.xyz/): Search and read public context snapshots.
- [Share](https://loooom.xyz/share): Preview a public GitHub file and share it.
- [Context guide](https://loooom.xyz/AGENTS.md): Source records, routes, and usage.
- [Personal evals](https://loooom.xyz/evals): Open local paired-evaluation reports.
- [Eval plugin guide](https://loooom.xyz/evals/plugin): Run the local eval plugin.

## Skills and Gym

- [Skills](https://loooom.xyz/browse): Reusable agent skills.
- [Gym](https://loooom.xyz/gym): Skill repair and ablation reports.
- [Skills source](https://github.com/mager/loooom): Skills catalog repository.

## Existing ME.md tools

- [ME.md](https://loooom.xyz/me): Personal context tools.
- [ME.md specification](https://loooom.xyz/me/spec): File format and sections.
- [ME.md schema](https://loooom.xyz/me-md-schema.json): Frontmatter validation.
- [Public directory](https://loooom.xyz/api/directory): Public ME.md profiles.

Public profile text uses /me/{username}/raw. New GitHub snapshot readers use
/h/{id}; each shows its exact source commit, update date, and line count.

## Open source

- [Website and eval plugin](https://github.com/mager/loooom.xyz)
